nodes.name: Evolution API Webhook
nodes.notes: Configure this URL in Evolution API as the webhook for MESSAGES_UPSERT events on your instance.

nodes.name: Filter: Media Only
nodes.notes: Only forward messages that contain a downloadable file. Text/reaction/status events are dropped.

nodes.name: Filter: Groups Only
nodes.notes: Only process messages from group chats (remoteJid ends with @g.us). Individual DMs are ignored.

nodes.name: Evolution: Decrypt & Get Base64
nodes.notes: Evolution API decrypts the WhatsApp media encryption and returns the file as base64. This is required — the raw CDN URL contains encrypted bytes that cannot be opened directly.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ groupId: $('Filter: Groups Only').item.json.body.data.key.remoteJid, sender: $('Filter: Groups Only').item.json.body.data.key.participant || $('Filter: Groups Only').item.json.body.data.key.remoteJid, messageId: $('Filter: Groups Only').item.json.body.data.key.id, fileName: $('Filter: Groups Only').item.json.body.data.message?.documentMessage?.fileName || $('Filter: Groups Only').item.json.body.data.message?.imageMessage?.caption || ($('Filter: Groups Only').item.json.body.data.messageType + '_' + $('Filter: Groups Only').item.json.body.data.key.id), fileBase64: $json.base64, mimeType: $json.mimetype || $('Filter: Groups Only').item.json.body.data.message?.documentMessage?.mimetype || $('Filter: Groups Only').item.json.body.data.message?.imageMessage?.mimetype || 'application/octet-stream' }) }}

nodes.name: POST to CRM Webhook
nodes.notes: Sends decrypted file as base64 to the CRM backend. Backend decodes → uploads to MinIO → inserts inbox_files row.

parameters.errorMessage: CRM webhook returned an error — check execution log

nodes.name: Log Error
nodes.notes: No retry loop — the CRM webhook is idempotent (dedup by messageId). If it fails, review logs.

notes: Required env vars in n8n: CRM_BACKEND_URL (e.g. https://your-crm.railway.app), WEBHOOK_SECRET
In Evolution API: set this workflow's webhook URL for event MESSAGES_UPSERT on your instance
The Evolution API decrypt call (getBase64FromMediaMessage) is mandatory — WhatsApp CDN URLs contain encrypted bytes.
Evolution API delivers ALL group messages from ALL monitored groups — the CRM resolves the right engagement by groupId
Files from groups not linked to any engagement are stored in unmatched_inbox for manual review
